svg.title: Current Requirements Workflow
svg.desc: Updated example-style diagram. Includes all stages S0 to S2H, central downstream coherence, Stage 3 SRS, Stage 4 ARS, Stage 5 DRS, Stage 6 Digital IPOS, Stage 7 Analog IPOS, and separate advisory review reporting. All specifications consume the same approved immutable snapshot; connectors do not infer requirement parentage.
svg.text: PRIMARY SOURCE INGESTION & ARCHITECTURE MAPPING PIPELINE
Only S1 reads sources. S2+ consume artifacts.
All generators consume the same approved immutable snapshot
Approved block-local allocation / shared preflight / existing gates

g.text: Direct source lineage allowed; no invented parents.
Arrows do not establish requirement parents.
- Deterministic stages and gates enforce quality and consistency.
- Approved snapshots are immutable; exact IDs preserve traceability.
- Outputs and indexes are derived and replaceable, not authority.
- Covers uses approved lineage, not a fixed end-to-end hierarchy.
- Execution: 3 - 4 - 5 - 6 - 7. Stop on failure; no gate weakening.
Every artifact is traceable. Every decision is recorded.
